text: Implemented truthful scheduler timing across core, CLI, focused scontrol diagnostics, and agent wire. Queue JSON parses actual/expected starts, projected end, and limited/unlimited facts; malformed optional timing cannot erase an observation. Explicit JobObservation codecs preserve legacy absence and are pinned by a golden fixture. Canonical Scala 3.7.4 gate passed: formatting, acceptance harnesses, 162 tests, and worker package.
